title: The Mega-IPO Curse: Surging on Day One, Slumping Within a Year. Can Anthropic Defy History?
author: OutcomeRich987
selftext: [Anthropic’s about to make history as the biggest-ever AI IPO, raking in $8.1B with a $1.5T implied valuation. ](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1005174642?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)History shows most big tech IPOs pop hard on debut, then slump within a year when hype can’t match expectations. This one’s got a massive retail investor pool too—sentiment could supercharge early moves but crush it fast if guidance underwhelms. Do you think it’ll break that infamous curse?

comments.author: Formally-Fresh
comments.body: Is up 17% surging??  I don’t really think so

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the date I'd circle isn't day one, it's lockup expiry. employees and early holders can usually start selling around six months in, and a lot of those first-year slumps begin right there rather than when the hype fades.
